messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: more examples
parts:
On Jan 13, 5:53 pm, Bob Carpenter <c...@alias-i.com> wrote:
> What's the best way to specify a platform so
> we can configure make for it?

The difficulty with a "Linux" section of a makefile is there is really
no such thing. Instead you have several major and countless minor
implementations of Linux and no real expectation of what compiler
versions and whatnot they might have. So, I don't even know what code
to execute to test whether a machine is Ubuntu, Debian, RedHat,
openSUSE, etc.
